profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a for-profit public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It trades under the ticker SFTBF and has SEC Central Index Key 0001065521. Its official website identifies Masayoshi Son as Representative Director, Chairman and President Executive Officer.

The company's site describes itself as the official source for SoftBank Group's philosophy, vision, strategy, corporate information, investor relations, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information. It also presents the company's views on the AI revolution and the possibilities AI brings, along with initiatives by group companies.
